nodes_full._readme: Fuller node interpretations (Jones book digest, 2026-06-12) — 'expand a bit, lay it out' per Katie.
nodes_full.juNN: Jupiter's north node (Cancer, our era): the most progressive vision available — faith re-rooted in home, belonging, and the felt sense of a human family. A point here offers its function as new collective belief; what this person teaches, publishes, or stands for is meant to feed people, not empires. The degree stays live for life: transits here time the milestones of the calling.
nodes_full.juSN: Jupiter's south node (Capricorn, our era): the whole inheritance of organized belief — doctrine, institution, the law of the fathers. A point here carries the gift AND the weight of old systems of thought; the work is to keep the wisdom while letting the scaffolding go. Often marks a born scholar of traditions.
nodes_full.saNN: Saturn's north node (Cancer, our era): maturity re-imagined — structure in service of care, authority that protects rather than dominates. A point here is asked to BUILD something that makes people feel safe; responsibility becomes nourishing. Events here tend to formalize: contracts, offices, foundations.
nodes_full.saSN: Saturn's south node (Capricorn, our era): the conditioning past itself — hierarchy, scarcity logic, the rules as they were handed down. A point here knows the old order from the inside (a gift for administration and history) and is haunted by it; the Jones war-tables open conflicts on contacts to this axis. What forms here is durable, for better and worse.
nodes_full.urNN: Uranus's north node (Gemini): liberation through learning out loud — plural inquiry, conversation, technology that connects. A point here is meant to break a silence: name the thing, share the data, democratize the insight. Breakthroughs (and sudden exposure) time to this degree.
nodes_full.urSN: Uranus's south node (Sagittarius): the collective trauma carried in belief itself — fundamentalism, the crusade, truth weaponized. A point here has lived inside a conviction system and bears its scars; the medicine is many small truths over one big one. Shocks here re-open old certainty wounds before freeing them.
nodes_full.neNN: Neptune's north node (Leo): the healing vision delivered PERSONALLY — creativity as offering, the heart on stage for something larger. A point here is asked: what does your one performance give the collective dream? Wars end and treaties sign on contacts here (Jones); grace arrives through individual gesture.
nodes_full.neSN: Neptune's south node (Aquarius): the old collective dream — utopias, ideologies, the group's inherited image of heaven. A point here is fluent in mass yearning (propaganda or poetry, same antenna); the work is discernment between the dream that heals and the fog that dissolves.
nodes_full.plNN: Pluto's north node (Cancer, our era): transformation completed as homecoming — power composted into protection of the vulnerable. A point here can metabolize collective crisis into rebirth; it marks people through whom the deep change becomes personal, livable, real. Pluto was DISCOVERED on this node.
nodes_full.plSN: Pluto's south node (Capricorn, our era): the underworld of civilization — dynasty, purge, the compulsive reach for control that built and broke empires. The 2020 Saturn–Pluto conjunction sat exactly here. A point here touches the master complex of the age: security through domination, and the long reckoning with it.
